_comment: Which processes are using the network, from the kernel's per-socket byte counters via `ss -tine` plus /proc/<pid>/fd for attribution. TCP only — UDP has no counters to read, so QUIC, DNS and Tailscale's own traffic are invisible. Totals start at zero each launch.
_limit_comment: Maximum process rows; 0 means no configured limit.
_sort_comment: Initial ordering: total bytes or live rate.
_external_comment: Whether traffic with off-machine peers is included.
_mine_comment: Whether the initial view is limited to this user’s processes.
